title: houttea gardneri
intro: Houttea gardneri, commonly known as the Ti Kuan Yin or Iron Buddha tea plant, is a type of evergreen shrub native to the mountains of China. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and aiding in weight loss due to its high antioxidant and catechin content. The therapeutic actions of Houttea gardneri include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of Houttea gardneri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
